newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks drift lower in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks drift lower in London trading.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks drifted lower in London trading on Monday as the market failed to follow up a strong rise in shares in Hong Kong.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was down 20.90 points, or 0.16 percent, at 13,423.03 by 1505 GMT, after the Hang Seng in Hong Kong leapt 221.14 points or 1.7 percent to 13,443.93.
"It was a good market in Hong Kong but shares here have really done very little," said a trader at one top brokerage.
In Hong Kong, shares were led higher by property and finance stocks as the market took its lead from gains on Wall Street on Friday.
